ideas.name: FTSE Rebalancing Auction Short
ideas.claim: On index review event days, the FTSE 100 tends to fall into the closing auction print.
ideas.quote: The rule is as simple as the mechanism: on event days, sell in the last cash hour and buy back after the auction print.
ideas.mechanism: Index rebalancing flows at the closing auction

rules.entry: Sell 15 to 60 minutes before the cash close on an event day; exact entry minute not stated.
rules.exit: Buy back after the auction print; exact exit time not stated.
rules.filters: Trading day of the closing auction before the effective date of quarterly FTSE 100, STOXX or MSCI index reviews.

ideas.claimed_result: The source reports a net average of 11.5 basis points per event day across 27 holdout days from January 2023 to June 2026, assuming 1.5 index points per round trip.
required_data: FTSE 100 CFD intraday prices reflecting the auction print
FTSE 100, STOXX and MSCI index review dates
